When_an_HTTP_request_is_received.description: POST an order. The stylesheet is written in the workflow itself (mapSource inline) and produces text.

Compose_using_XSLT.description: Inline map: no deployment needed, but it cannot include or import other modules.

parameters.xslt: <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"><xsl:output method="text"/><xsl:param name="separator" select="';'"/><xsl:template match="/Order"><xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(Number)"/><xsl:value-of select="$separator"/><xsl:value-of select="CustomerId"/><xsl:value-of select="$separator"/><xsl:value-of select="count(Lines/Line)"/><xsl:value-of select="$separator"/><xsl:value-of select="sum(Lines/Line/Quantity)"/></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>
